cardPages.title: StarCraft II Community APIs
cardPages.cardDescription: Endpoints for StarCraft II player profiles, ladder data, and achievements.

cardPages.title: StarCraft II Game Data APIs
cardPages.cardDescription: Endpoints for StarCraft II league data.

html:
StarCraft II provides APIs to access data for such things as player profiles, ladders, achivements and league data.

Before you can use the APIs, you must set up your client and secret as described in Getting Started.
